**Onimusha 3: Demon Siege Widescreen Fix** corrects resolution handling, aspect ratio, HUD scaling, field of view and video scaling for widescreen displays.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#onimusha3) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/Onimusha3.WidescreenFix/dllmain.cpp)

</div>

---

## Configuration

Configure on fusionfix.io or in FusionFixHub. Resolution defaults to the desktop size; set a width and height to choose another size, then restart. Resolution is excluded from presets. Video Mode changes apply during playback: Original keeps the whole 4:3 picture with black bars, Fill crops it to cover the screen, and Stretch fills the screen without preserving its proportions. Recommended and Enhanced use Fill; Vanilla uses Original. An old `scripts/Onimusha3.WidescreenFix.ini` isn't used anymore and can be deleted.

The fix corrects resolution, clipping, 3D/HUD/background/movie framing and effect overlays; invalid dimensions are bounded. There is no anti-aliasing option.

Extract the release archive into the game directory, preserving folders, then launch the game. Configure on fusionfix.io or in FusionFixHub.

## Known limits

- There is no adjustable gameplay FOV, HUD aspect constraint, cutscene-border control, intro skip or window-mode control. Resolution changes require a restart.
- HUD and backgrounds use a centered 4:3 layout. They have not been checked throughout the game at 32:9 or on narrow screens.

## Notes

There is no in-game options menu; configure the fix on fusionfix.io or in FusionFixHub.
